November 3, 2026

This is your official 2026 General Election Voters’
Pamphlet. It is meant to help you cast your vote by
mail ballot. Ballots will be mailed to registered voters
beginning October 14.
Included in this pamphlet are election deadlines,
voter registration information, your rights as an
Oregon voter, candidate statements, and measure
information.
